instruction: Help me change VLC subtitle font size to large (16)

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to change VLC subtitle font size to 16 (large) by setting 'freetype-rel-fontsize=16' in vlcrc. The evaluator reads the configuration file and verifies the font size setting. VLC uses values like 16 for large, 18 for larger, etc. Default is 0 (automatic).
